fixed.summary: A TSX element's `data-*` props drive its classes' `data-<name>:` variants, and `group-data-<name>/<group>:` reads the nearest ancestor `group/<group>`'s: `data-on={props.on}` with `data-on:bg-accent` now marks it. A prop is on unless its value is empty or `false`; changing it restyles the element and the group's descendants that read it.
